summary: Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW) is dutch learned society, founded in 1808. Type: public sector / education / research. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: The Dutch Royal Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW), founded in 1808, runs research institutes such as NIOO, which studies ecology and biodiversity in Wageningen.

culture.text: Openings are research roles at KNAW institutes, such as NIOO in Wageningen, which researches biodiversity, climate change and sustainable land and water use.
NIOO describes its staff as people who each want to help build a sustainable world from their own field.
Current jobs are in Amsterdam (2) and Wageningen (1), and all of them show the pay.

open.text: All 3 of its current openings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so check visa support if you need one.

worth_knowing.text: A learned society founded in 1808, based at the Trippenhuis in Amsterdam, with 14 subsidiary organisations listed.
